methodologyDecision.rationale: Automated checks verify internal consistency of the conservative ALFRED AvailableAt convention. They do not by themselves establish that the convention is scientifically sufficient for calibration.

notes: This review checks consistency between ALFRED realtime_start and the conservative end-of-day UTC AvailableAt convention.
The script does not promote observations.
A successful automated review is necessary but not sufficient for methodological approval.
Historical admission remains disabled until an explicit methodological decision is documented.
